title: The Ahmedabad Factor: Stadium Scale and Scoring Records for Gujarat Titans
dek: Narendra Modi Stadium leads venues with an {{ev:hg-rr-home}} run rate, {{ev:hg-six-home}} sixes per match, and a {{ev:hg-first-home}} average first innings score. Gujarat Titans have converted this scale into a {{ev:hg-home-win}} home win rate.
excerpt: Ahmedabad has been higher-scoring than the average IPL venue. Gujarat Titans home record against their away record shows high baseline scoring.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

GT have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} at home and {{ev:hg-away-win}} elsewhere; the ninety-five per cent interval on the home figure is {{ev:hg-home-ci}}.

sections.heading: What Makes Ahmedabad Different
body: Across {{ev:hg-home-matches}} matches in the CricField warehouse, Ahmedabad has produced a run rate of {{ev:hg-rr-home}} against {{ev:hg-rr-other}} at other IPL venues, {{ev:hg-six-home}} sixes per match against {{ev:hg-six-other}}, and an average first-innings score of {{ev:hg-first-home}} against {{ev:hg-first-other}}.
Chasing sides have won {{ev:hg-chase-home}} of decided matches there, against {{ev:hg-chase-other}} elsewhere.

sections.heading: Does the Ground Favour the Home Side?
body: Gujarat Titans have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} of their {{ev:hg-home-n}} decided matches at Ahmedabad and {{ev:hg-away-win}} of matches elsewhere. The ninety-five per cent interval around the home figure is {{ev:hg-home-ci}}; a home record at least this far from even would arise by chance with probability {{ev:hg-home-p}}.
On this evidence there is no statistically clear home advantage for GT.

sections.heading: Turning Conditions Into an Edge
body: A distinctive ground only helps the home side if the squad is built for it in ways visitors cannot copy. Toss winners at Ahmedabad have chosen to bowl first {{ev:hg-toss-field}} of the time, so the toss decision itself is rarely the edge.
The levers are squad composition and preparation: bowlers whose skills suit the surface and batters who know where the scoring areas are.

sections.heading: What a Home-Away Split Hides
body: Away records include neutral venues and seasons played away from home, and home records span eras with very different squads. A matched comparison would be fairer than this raw split.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Distinctive Is Not the Same as Decisive
body: Ahmedabad has been higher-scoring than the average venue, and the record shows no statistically clear home advantage for Gujarat Titans.
A home edge has to be engineered through squad design rather than assumed.

methodology: Regulation innings only (super overs excluded); win rates use matches with a result. Generated from the CricField warehouse by scripts/editorial/engine. The home ground combines every venue name used for it in the source. The interval is a Wilson interval; the probability is a two-sided exact binomial test against 50%.
